pattern: three-model reviewer: one child per model
experience: A reviewer role saved with three models must run all three on one identical brief, launched together, not review with one model or serialize the children.
rule: A role may list up to three models, its targets, for independent perspectives. Run every target: write the brief once, launch every target with delegate_task before awaiting child completion

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: Have my reviewers review the committed diff on this branch against main. Read only; nothing should change.

pattern: /orca review step fans a two-model reviewer out
experience: Under /orca the reviewer step must reach every model of a two-model reviewer from the same frozen checkout, without the parent editing while they run.
rule: Use the team's reviewer role when there is one, on every model it lists, from the same frozen checkout: make no edits or commits until every reviewer has ended.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: /orca The retry change on this branch is already committed and final. Only get it reviewed against main for correctness.

pattern: one-model reviewer: one child on that model
experience: A reviewer saved with one model keeps today's behavior: exactly one child on that model and its saved options.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: Have my reviewer review the committed diff on this branch against main. Read only; nothing should change.

pattern: a model the user names beats a three-model role
experience: When the user names one model for a review, the agent runs only that model, not the reviewer role's three.
rule: A model the user names in their message wins over the team: run only that model.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: Have GPT-6 Luna alone review the committed diff on this branch against main. Only that model, nothing else. Read only.

pattern: two-model implementer: each writer gets its own worktree
experience: Two models that both change files must not share one checkout: each needs a tool-created worktree from the same commit, and the parent must not commit or create worktrees itself.
rule: Children that change files each need isolation:"worktree", launched together from the same commit; never commit the user's uncommitted work for them or let two children edit one checkout.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: Have both of my implementers add one retry to src/client.ts from the committed main, each their own version, so I can compare them. Do not merge either.

pattern: uncommitted work that writers need is explained, not dropped or committed
experience: Two writers need the user's uncommitted edit, but a worktree starts from the commit: the agent must say so rather than commit for the user, start writers without it, or let both edit the shared checkout.
rule: Uncommitted edits stay out of a worktree, so if a child needs them, tell the user instead of dropping them. Never commit the user's uncommitted work for them.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). This is the local machine.

prompt: Have both of my implementers continue from my uncommitted edit in src/client.ts and make the retry count configurable, each their own version. Don't commit anything of mine.
